verdict.rationale: Batch processing is a fair question for a transcription API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents single-item operations: one `gladia transcribe audio.mp3` per CLI call, and API calls taking a single file or URL. Scriptable output, no-code automation partners (Zapier/Make/n8n) and volume pricing are user-side workarounds or adjacent features, not a documented bulk or batch operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
